description: Read BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON text and return the entries in one normalized shape: lower case field names, tidy whitespace, bare DOIs, the year filled in from a date, and authors split into "Family, Given". Nothing is sent anywhere. Example: text "@article{k1, AUTHOR = {John Smith and Jane Doe}, title={Deep Learning for Graphs}, year={2024}}" returns one entry with authors ["Smith, John", "Doe, Jane"] and lower case field names. Leave format out unless auto picks the wrong one.

format.description: The format of the text. Defaults to auto, which looks at the text to decide.

text.description: The reference list as text: BibTeX, RIS or CSL JSON.

name: parse_bibliography

fields.description: Every field of the entry, with lower case names.

type.description: The BibTeX entry type, like article or book.

format.description: The format that was read: bibtex, ris or csl_json.

title: Parse a bibliography
